# MEGG — Curated Men's Fashion India

> MEGG is India's premier curated men's fashion catalog & discovery platform. We handpick top-rated T-shirts, shirts, jeans, shoes, jackets, hoodies, track pants, perfume, body care, and accessories from leading Indian and international brands.

## Core Value Proposition
- **Curated Discovery**: Unlike generic multi-brand marketplaces (like Myntra or Ajio) that list millions of unverified items, MEGG curates only top-tier, trending men's fashion items daily.
- **Direct Brand Redirection**: Users browse handpicked styles on MEGG with transparent pricing and click through directly to the brand's official site to complete the purchase.
- **Budget-Friendly Fashion**: Includes a dedicated "Under ₹699" section for affordable high-quality men's fashion starting at ₹299.
- **Daily New Arrivals**: Fresh styles, street fashion, formalwear, athleisure, and daily essentials updated daily.

## Primary Navigation & Categories
- [All Products](https://www.meggfashion.in/products): Full catalog of curated men's fashion.
- [Under ₹699](https://www.meggfashion.in/under699): Budget-friendly clothing and accessories under ₹699.
- [Shirts](https://www.meggfashion.in/category/Shirt): Casual, formal, linen, printed, and denim shirts.
- [T-Shirts](https://www.meggfashion.in/category/Tshirt): Oversized, graphic, polo, solid, and vintage tees.
- [Jeans](https://www.meggfashion.in/category/Jeans): Slim, straight, wide-leg, relaxed, and cargo jeans.
- [Shoes](https://www.meggfashion.in/category/Shoes): Sneakers, loafers, boots, running shoes, and formal footwear.
- [Jackets](https://www.meggfashion.in/category/Jacket): Bomber, denim, leather, puffer, and blazer jackets.
- [Hoodies & Sweatshirts](https://www.meggfashion.in/category/Hoodies): Streetwear hoodies, fleece sweatshirts, and pullovers.
- [Track Pants & Joggers](https://www.meggfashion.in/category/Trackpants): Cargo joggers, sweatpants, and athleisure bottoms.
- [Perfume & Body Care](https://www.meggfashion.in/category/Perfume): Men's fragrances, cologne, grooming, and body care.
- [Accessories](https://www.meggfashion.in/category/Mens%20Accessories): Caps, sunglasses, belts, wallets, and socks.

- Available on Android and iOS for a seamless mobile fashion discovery experience with reels and style recommendations.
